title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
requirement: Rental housing providers may not inquire about, require disclosure of, or use criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection or decisions, and may not refuse to rent, terminate a tenancy, or charge more based on criminal history.
coverage_conditions: All rental housing providers in Berkeley, except lifetime sex offenders, limited public housing/Section 8 exemptions, owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units, owner move-back units, and units where existing tenants sublet or add/replace roommates.

conditions.who: owner-occupied, owner of record resides in one unit as primary residence

conditions.text: public housing and Section 8 properties (limited exemptions)

applicability.per_tenancy: Lifetime sex offenders; units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back under BMC 13.76.130 A.9; units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
coverage_quotes: Owner-occupied properties (between 1-3 units) in which an owner of record resides in one of the units as their primary residence

exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; public housing/Section 8 properties (limited exemptions); owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units; units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back under BMC 13.76.130 A.9; units where existing tenants sublet or add/replace roommates.
penalty: Administrative fines of at least $1,000 and up to $10,000 per violation; civil damages including actual damages or three times one month's rent, punitive damages, attorneys' fees and costs, and injunctive relief.
quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
